risks.title: Interest rates
risks.summary: Interest rates could impact the cost of financing and investment returns
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate fluctuations directly affect HASI's financing costs and investment returns. The company relies significantly on debt to fund its investments.

risks.title: Inflation and electricity prices
risks.summary: Inflation and electricity price fluctuations could impact returns from sustainable infrastructure projects
risks.score_rationale: Rising electricity prices could affect returns from renewable energy projects and the profitability of portfolio assets.

risks.title: Climate risks
risks.summary: Climate events could impact energy demand and investment returns
risks.score_rationale: Extreme climate events could affect the physical performance of renewable energy assets and returns on sustainable infrastructure investments.

risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: Competition in the sustainable infrastructure market could impact company returns
risks.score_rationale: Increasing competition in the sustainable infrastructure market could affect returns and the ability to deploy capital at desired return levels.

risks.title: Regulatory risks
risks.summary: Regulatory changes could impact company returns
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes related to renewable energy, tax incentives, and financing regulations could impact investment returns.

risks.title: Credit risks
risks.summary: Credit risks and potential loan losses could affect company returns
risks.score_rationale: The credit quality of borrowers and counterparties could affect returns and loan loss provisions. HASI recorded $12.1 million in provisions in 2025.

risks.title: Operational risks
risks.summary: Operational risks could impact company returns
risks.score_rationale: Operational risks related to managing a complex portfolio of over 700 transactions could impact investment performance.
